newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila shares end up for fifth straight session.
newsitem.headline: Manila shares end up for fifth straight session.

text.p: * PLDT supports index rise, Mondragon takes centerstage
The Manila share index ended higher on Friday for the fifth straight session, gaining 38.78 points, or 1.20 percent, to 3,262.14 points on a steep rise in market heavyweight PLDT, traders said.

"People started buying back PLDT, which is a big component of the index, along with firstliners Philippine National Bank, San Miguel and Meralco, on the back of Wall Street's rise," said Jose Ricardo Garcia, executive vice-president at Diversified Securities Inc.
